title: DevPass Attestation Reference Schema
description: Non-normative public reference interface for representing a third-party attestation associated with a DevPass developer record.

subject_reference.description: Reference to the developer or developer record associated with the attestation.

attestation_type.description: Simplified public reference category for the attestation.

issuer_reference.description: Reference to the organization, institution, platform, verifier, or other source issuing the attestation.

claim_reference.description: Optional reference to the statement, claim, credential, activity, or evidence being attested.

issued_at.description: Timestamp at which the attestation was issued.

provenance_reference.description: Optional implementation-defined provenance or integrity reference.

metadata.description: Optional implementation-specific metadata. Consumers should not treat metadata as normative trust or weighting semantics.
